purpose: Declare, for every historical report, its frozen bytes and whether the current generator still reproduces it. A drift that is not declared here fails the verification test that reads this file.

hashRules.frozenSha256: SHA-256 of the committed bytes, LF-normalized. Identity only: it says the file was not edited.
hashRules.observedSha256: SHA-256 of the generator's current output, excluding run metadata (generatedAt, environment). For a report with no run metadata this is its raw hash.

reports.cause: The attribution model gained a `checkpoint-root` bucket after the report was generated. Every workload total is unchanged; the root fold's framing/identity/rationale tokens are now reported under `checkpoint-root` (W1 3,240; W3 5,160; W4 4,560) instead of being spread across the three older buckets.
reports.promotion: not performed: the committed bytes are the R1 record

reports.cause: The committed report is a scorerVersion 2 record; the current scorer is 3 and its per-row `behaviour` object carries the R36/R37 fields (functionalSuccess, contractSuccess, verification assessment, finishGuard, harness). The dataset digest is unchanged; the scripted arms' damage count is one higher because the current scorer classifies one previously unscored case as damage.
reports.promotion: not performed: the committed bytes are the R33 offline record
